newsitem.title: USA: Molecular Biosystems files for FDA approval.
newsitem.headline: Molecular Biosystems files for FDA approval.

text.p: Molecular Biosystems Inc and Mallinckrodt Inc said on Friday they had filed a pre-marketing approval application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for FS069, Molecular's second-generation ultrasound imaging agent.
FS069 is designed to enhance ultrasound imaging by enabling doctors to see blood flow and enhance resolution of anatomical structures.
The filing involved studies for cardiac function. The studies focus on enhancing delineation of the endocardial border and determining the ability of the agent to shade the left ventricular chamber.
FS069 is licensed to Mallinckrodt in North and South America, China, Australia and New Zealand.

Molecular Biosystems developed and manufactures FS069, while Mallinckrodt is responsible for sales and marketing. Molecular Biosystems is currently in advanced discussions with a European partner and is pursuing discussions for its recently reacquired Far East territories.
